mechanism: A product film can move from a human outcome to isolated product identity, then to one legible internal or material proof, return to a broader human result and finish on a stable product state. This source is additional evidence for the existing flexible product proof state machine, not a new selector.

invariants.rule: Establish one emotionally readable outcome related to the product.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cold product opening lacks motivation.

invariants.rule: Isolate the product identity before technical proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unidentified mechanism shots become generic texture.

invariants.rule: Show one visible operation or material proof.
invariants.purpose: Answers how the result is produced.
invariants.ablation_failure: A beauty shot alone cannot prove function.

invariants.rule: Return to a broader result state after proof.
invariants.purpose: Connects mechanism back to people or environment.

invariants.rule: End on a clean stable product state.
invariants.ablation_failure: A moving montage ending weakens identity.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: bar friends, can, bottle, foam and toast

instantiations.concept: An office begins with tired workers, isolates an original air-quality device, proves filter airflow with particles and a gauge, returns to visibly relaxed workers, then ends on the device with a clean-air indicator.
